header.userPrompt:
Finish applying the web module's form principle to the last two `FormData` classes that still hold raw user inputs: `MerchantFormData` and `RefundFormData`. Web module only. Do NOT change any API request/response models, and do NOT add anything to `lib/common` or `lib/api`. Keep every new validated type under `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits`.

## The principle (already documented, already enforced on the other forms)

On a `FormData` subclass, every field holding a value the user can enter or choose is a `FormField[T]` over a validated primitive, and every such field is in the `fields` list so `isValid` covers it. The only non-`FormField` members allowed are a `Boolean` and a genuine non-edited pass-through context id. See the rule in `.orca/reviewers/frontend.md` (the FormData sections). `SubscriptionFormData`, `BankRowRefundFormData`, `BankRowExpenseFormData`, `ExpenseFormData`, `ReceiptConfirmFormData`, `BulkExpenseFormData` already follow it; these two were left as a follow-up and now need the same treatment.

## Existing tools to reuse (do not re-create)

- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpNotes.scala` — bounded notes primitive with a `given` optional validator. Input objects `NotesInput` / `OptionalNotesInput` are in `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/components/inputs/expInputs.scala`.
- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpOptionalId.scala` — `FormField[Option[UUID]]` validator for an existing-only id selection (blank = None, else a well-formed UUID). Input object `OptionalIdSelectInput` is in `expInputs.scala`.
- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExistingSelections.scala` — `defaultCategoryId(merchantId, merchants)` and helpers; keep using it.
- Primitive templates to mirror for the one new primitive: `ExpNotes.scala` (a `WrappedString`-style bounded text clone) and `lib/common/.../CategoryDescription.scala` (shape only; do not edit lib).
- Reference FormData + spec shape: `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/BankRowRefundFormData.scala` and its spec under `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/forms`.

## New primitive to add

`web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpTaxId.scala` — a bounded free-text tax-id primitive built like `ExpNotes`: `MaxLength = 50` (matches the server, which rejects a tax id over 50 chars in `CreateMerchantAction`/`UpdateMerchantAction`). Provide `validate`/`parse`/`trusted`, a `given TextValidator`, and a `given` optional validator (blank = `None`). Add input objects to `expInputs.scala` (`TaxIdInput` / `OptionalTaxIdInput`) following the existing ones; no hardcoded React key in a reusable input (derive from the field name). Add a spec `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpTaxIdSpec.scala` (plain ScalaTest, describe blocks named by method only, e.g. `"validate"` not `"ExpTaxId.validate"`).

Notes fields reuse `ExpNotes` (consistent with the other forms); do not add a second notes primitive.

## Fix 1: MerchantFormData + MerchantsPage

File: `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/MerchantFormData.scala`, rendered by `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/merchants/MerchantsPage.scala`.

- `notes: String` -> `FormField[Option[ExpNotes]]`.
- `categoryId: String` -> `FormField[Option[UUID]]` via `ExpOptionalId` / `OptionalIdSelectInput` (MerchantsPage picks an existing category from a select; this is existing-only, not pick-or-create, so no `ExistingOrNewValue`).
- `taxId: String` -> `FormField[Option[ExpTaxId]]`.
- Put all of these in `fields` so `isValid` covers them. Keep `name` as is. Keep both `submitRequest` (-> `CreateMerchant.Request`) and `updateRequest` (-> `UpdateMerchant.Request`); map the field values to the existing request shapes (notes/taxId become `Option[String]` via the primitive's `.string`, categoryId stays `Option[UUID]`). Drop the hand-written `parsedCategoryId` `Try(UUID.fromString)` and the `formValidationErrors` that only re-expresses field validity; rely on `isValid`. Seed fields from source with the raw value (no `.trim`/`.take`, no `.trusted`). Remove the now-stale "length is validated by the action" comment.
- Update `MerchantsPage` to render the validated inputs (`OptionalNotesInput`, `OptionalIdSelectInput`, `OptionalTaxIdInput`) and gate submit on `isValid` through the existing `useSubmit` handle. Keep js/MUI interop inside the component.

## Fix 2: RefundFormData + RefundsPage

File: `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/RefundFormData.scala`, rendered by `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/expenses/RefundsPage.scala`.

- `merchantId: Option[UUID]` -> `FormField[Option[UUID]]` via `ExpOptionalId` / `OptionalIdSelectInput` (RefundsPage uses existing-only selects).
- `categoryId: Option[UUID]` -> `FormField[Option[UUID]]` the same way.
- `notes: String` -> `FormField[Option[ExpNotes]]`.
- Put all three in `fields`. Preserve the `withMerchant` behavior (picking a merchant sets the category to that merchant's default via `ExistingSelections.defaultCategoryId`, clearing it when the merchant has none) - now operating on the `FormField`s rather than raw ids. `submitRequest` keeps returning the same `Resolved` shape. Seed from `fromRefund` with raw values.
- Update `RefundsPage` to render the validated select/notes inputs and gate submit on `isValid`.

## Specs

- Add/update `MerchantFormDataSpec` and `RefundFormDataSpec` under `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/forms` (plain ScalaTest, no jsdom): `submitRequest`/`updateRequest` yield a request when valid and `None` when a required field is missing or any field is invalid, and `RefundFormData.withMerchant` sets the default category. Method-only describe blocks.
- `ExpTaxIdSpec` as above.

## Acceptance criteria

- `web` compiles.
- `MerchantFormData` and `RefundFormData` hold no raw user-input member: every input is a `FormField` over a validated primitive and is in `fields`. (No `Boolean`/pass-through-id members are involved here.)
- New `ExpTaxId` primitive + inputs added with a spec; `MerchantFormDataSpec` and `RefundFormDataSpec` added/updated; all pass. Describe blocks method-only.
- No `.trusted` on user input; validated fields seeded raw; submit gated on `isValid` with no hand-written required/validity checks.
- No changes outside `web/`; no API request/response model changes; nothing added to `lib/`.
- All reviewer gates in `.orca/reviewers/frontend.md` satisfied. Repo is public: no PII anywhere.

Commit per form/primitive. Open a PR when done.

resultJson.description:
Finish moving the web module's forms onto validated inputs by converting the last two `FormData` classes that still hold raw user input: `MerchantFormData` (raw `notes`, `categoryId`, `taxId` strings) and `RefundFormData` (raw `merchantId`/`categoryId` `Option[UUID]` and a `notes` string). The rule is in `.orca/reviewers/frontend.md` ("Every FormData input is a validated FormField"): every value the user can enter or pick is a `FormField[T]` over a validated primitive, every such field is in `fields` so `isValid` covers it, and the submit button is gated on `isValid`. Other forms already follow it (`SubscriptionFormData`, `BankRowRefundFormData`, `ExpenseFormData`, …).

Notes reuse `ExpNotes`. Existing-only id selects reuse `ExpOptionalId` with `OptionalIdSelectInput`. The only new primitive is a web-only `ExpTaxId`: bounded text, max 50 characters, the same limit `CreateMerchantAction`/`UpdateMerchantAction` enforce on the server. It gets matching `TaxIdInput`/`OptionalTaxIdInput` objects. Values coming from the API are seeded raw, with no `.trim`, `.take` or `.trusted`, so the field's validator flags bad data. Hand-written checks (`parsedCategoryId`, `formValidationErrors`) go away.

Constraints: change only files under `web/`. Do not touch API request/response models or anything in `lib/`. `CreateMerchant.Request`/`UpdateMerchant.Request` and `RefundFormData.Resolved` keep their current shapes. Make one commit per primitive/form. Every FormData change comes with a plain ScalaTest spec whose describe blocks are named by method only. The repo is public, so test data must contain no PII.

tasks.title: Add ExpTaxId primitive, TaxIdInput/OptionalTaxIdInput, and ExpTaxIdSpec
tasks.description:
Create `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpTaxId.scala` by mirroring `ExpNotes.scala` exactly: `class ExpTaxId private (val string: String) extends WrappedString`, and `object ExpTaxId extends WrappedString.Companion[ExpTaxId]` with `val MaxLength: Int = 50`. `validate` trims, rejects `trimmed.length > MaxLength` with `s"Tax ID must be $MaxLength characters or less"` (same wording as the server) and otherwise returns `Valid(string, new ExpTaxId(trimmed))`. Also add `trusted`, `parse: Either[String, ExpTaxId]`, and `given optionalValidator: TextValidator[Option[ExpTaxId]] = OptionalValidator.optional(validate)`. The non-optional `TextValidator[ExpTaxId]` comes from `WrappedString.Companion`, as it does for `ExpNotes`/`NotesInput`. If it does not resolve, add `given validator: TextValidator[ExpTaxId] = (s: String) => validate(s)`. Scaladoc: a bounded tax id that matches the server's 50-char limit.

In `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/components/inputs/expInputs.scala`, import `ExpTaxId` and add `object TaxIdInput extends ValidatedTextInput[ExpTaxId]` and `object OptionalTaxIdInput extends ValidatedTextInput[Option[ExpTaxId]]` next to `NotesInput`/`OptionalNotesInput`. `ValidatedTextInput` already derives its id/name from `field.name` and has no hardcoded key.

Add `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpTaxIdSpec.scala` modeled on `ExpNotesSpec`, with blocks `"validate"`, `"parse"` and `"optionalValidator"`. Cover: a valid value round-trips through `.string`; the value is stored trimmed while `.input` keeps the original; exactly 50 chars is accepted; 51 chars is rejected with the message; `parse` returns Right or Left; blank or whitespace becomes `None`; a valid value is wrapped in `Some`; an over-limit optional value is rejected. Use synthetic ids like "TAX-123", not real tax numbers.

Verify: `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, then `sbt "web/testOnly *ExpTaxIdSpec"`. Commit, e.g. "Add ExpTaxId validated primitive and inputs".

tasks.title: Convert MerchantFormData to validated fields and update MerchantsPage
tasks.description:
Rewrite `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/MerchantFormData.scala` with these fields:
- `name: FormField[MerchantName]` — unchanged.
- `notes: FormField[Option[ExpNotes]]`
- `categoryId: FormField[Option[UUID]]`
- `taxId: FormField[Option[ExpTaxId]]`

Set `fields = List(name, notes, categoryId, taxId)`. Delete `parsedCategoryId`, the `formValidationErrors` override, the stale "length is validated by the action" comment, and the `scala.util.Try` import.

`submitRequest` should be a for-comprehension over `name.valueOpt`, `notes.valueOpt`, `categoryId.valueOpt` and `taxId.valueOpt`, yielding `CreateMerchant.Request(name = n, notes = no.map(_.string), categoryId = c, taxId = t.map(_.string))`. Keep `updateRequest` mapping that result to `UpdateMerchant.Request` as today.

In `initial(name: Option[String], notes: String, categoryId: String, taxId: String)`, seed each field raw:
- notes: `Some(ExpNotes.optionalValidator(notes))`
- categoryId: `Some(ExpOptionalId.validate(categoryId))`
- taxId: `Some(ExpTaxId.optionalValidator(taxId))`

All three are `required = false`, with labels "Notes (optional)", "Default category" and "Tax ID (optional)". The create and edit forms are on screen at the same time and DOM ids come from `field.name`. So add a `prefix: String` parameter ("merchant-create" / "merchant-edit") and use it in the new fields' names (`s"$prefix-notes"`, etc.), following `RefundFormData.amountField`. Leave the existing `name` field's name unchanged.

In `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/merchants/MerchantsPage.scala` (`MerchantList.component`), make these changes in both the create and edit forms:
- Replace the raw notes/tax `mui.TextField`s with `OptionalNotesInput.component(OptionalNotesInput.Props(field = form.notes, disabled = submit.isSubmitting, onChange = v => setForm(cur => cur.copy(notes = cur.notes.updated(v)))))` and the same pattern with `OptionalTaxIdInput`.
- Rewrite `categorySelector` to take the `FormField[Option[UUID]]` and render `OptionalIdSelectInput.component(OptionalIdSelectInput.Props(field, options = localCategories.map(c => c.id.toString -> c.name), onChange, disabled))`. Wrap it in a `mui.Box` with `minWidth` (the input is `fullWidth`) and keep the "+ Cat" button next to it. Delete `categoryItems`, because `ValidatedSelectInput` adds its own "(none)" item.
- In `handleCreateCategory`, set the new category with `cur.copy(categoryId = cur.categoryId.updated(ExpOptionalId.validate(resp.id.toString)))`.
- Gate the Add/Save buttons on `createSubmit.buttonDisabled(createForm.isValid)` / `editSubmit.buttonDisabled(editForm.isValid)` (Add also keeps `atLimit ||`).
- Update the `initial(...)` calls: the create reset, both `useState` seeds, and the Edit button seed, which keeps passing raw `m.notes.getOrElse("")`, `m.categoryId.map(_.toString).getOrElse("")` and `m.taxId.getOrElse("")`.

Leave the unrelated rule-pattern and new-category-name fields alone; they are component state, not this FormData.

Add `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/MerchantFormDataSpec.scala` (AnyWordSpec + must Matchers, describe blocks `"initial"`, `"submitRequest"`, `"updateRequest"`). Cover:
- A blank initial form is invalid and gives `None`.
- A valid form gives the expected `CreateMerchant.Request`: notes/taxId trimmed, blank → `None`, categoryId parsed.
- A missing name gives `None`.
- Over-limit notes (501 chars), an over-limit tax id (51 chars), or a malformed category id makes `isValid` false and both requests `None`.
- `updateRequest` mirrors the create values.
- An edit seed with an over-limit tax id keeps the raw input (`inputValue`) and is invalid.

Compare `name` through `.string`. Use synthetic data only.

Verify: `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, then `sbt "web/testOnly *MerchantFormDataSpec *MerchantListSpec"`. Commit, e.g. "Make MerchantFormData inputs validated FormFields".

tasks.title: Convert RefundFormData to validated fields and update RefundsPage
tasks.description:
Rewrite `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/RefundFormData.scala` with these fields:
- `merchantId: FormField[Option[UUID]]`
- `categoryId: FormField[Option[UUID]]`
- `notes: FormField[Option[ExpNotes]]`

Set `fields = List(amount, date, merchantId, categoryId, notes)`. `submitRequest` should be a for-comprehension over all five `valueOpt`s, yielding the unchanged `Resolved(amount = a.value, date = d.value, merchantId = m, categoryId = c, notes = n.map(_.string))`. Update the class scaladoc.

Change `withMerchant` to `withMerchant(value: ValidationResult[Option[UUID]], merchants: List[GetMerchants.Response.Merchant]): RefundFormData`. It sets `merchantId = merchantId.updated(value)` and `categoryId = categoryId.updated(ExpOptionalId.validate(ExistingSelections.defaultCategoryId(value.toOption.flatten, merchants).fold("")(_.toString)))`, so the category is cleared when the merchant has none or is unset, preserving today's behavior.

Add private field builders like `amountField`/`dateField` that keep the prefix scheme ("refund-create"/"refund-edit"; both forms are on screen at once):
- `merchantField(prefix, raw: String)` → name `s"$prefix-merchant"`, label "Merchant (optional)", value `Some(ExpOptionalId.validate(raw))`
- `categoryField` → label "Category (optional)", built the same way
- `notesField` → label "Notes (optional)", value `Some(ExpNotes.optionalValidator(raw))`

All are `required = false`. `initial` seeds them with "". `fromRefund` seeds them raw: `r.merchantId.map(_.toString).getOrElse("")`, the same for `categoryId`, and `r.notes.getOrElse("")` (no trim).

In `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/expenses/RefundsPage.scala` (`RefundList.component`), inside `formFields`:
- Replace `merchantOptions`/`categoryOptions` with `OptionalIdSelectInput.component(OptionalIdSelectInput.Props(field = formData.merchantId, options = props.merchants.data.map(m => m.id.toString -> m.name), disabled = disabled, onChange = v => update(_.withMerchant(v, props.merchants.data))))`. Do the same for category, with `onChange = v => update(cur => cur.copy(categoryId = cur.categoryId.updated(v)))`. Wrap each in `mui.Box` with `minWidth = "160px"`, since the input is fullWidth.
- Replace the notes TextField with `OptionalNotesInput`.
- Delete `parseId`, `merchantOptions` and `categoryOptions`, plus any imports that become unused (`scala.util.Try`; keep `dom`, which the search and filter fields still use).

The buttons already use `buttonDisabled(form.isValid)`. Keep `save` as is.

Update `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/RefundFormDataSpec.scala` for the new shape:
- Build the filled form via `.updated(ExpOptionalId.validate(...))` and `.updated(ExpNotes.optionalValidator(...))`.
- `"submitRequest"`: a valid form resolves, trimming notes; blank notes give `None`; a bad amount or date gives `None`; and add cases where a malformed merchant or category id, or 501-char notes, make `isValid` false and `submitRequest` `None`.
- `"fromRefund"`: round-trip, asserting `form.notes.inputValue`, `merchantId.inputValue` and so on.
- `"withMerchant"`: takes `ExpOptionalId.validate(store.id.toString)`; it sets the default category, clears the category for a merchant without a default, and clears both when the value is blank. Assert via `form.merchantId.valueOpt` / `form.categoryId.valueOpt` (expect `Some(Some(id))` / `Some(None)`).

Verify: `CI=true sbt Test/compile`, then `sbt "web/testOnly *RefundFormDataSpec"`. Commit, e.g. "Make RefundFormData inputs validated FormFields". After the final task, open the PR (title along the lines of "Validate MerchantFormData and RefundFormData inputs").

resultJson.brief:
MODULES
- `web/` (Scala.js + Slinky + MUI 5) is the only module to change. `lib/api/shared` (Tapir models such as `CreateMerchant.Request(name: MerchantName, notes: Option[String], categoryId: Option[UUID], taxId: Option[String])`, `UpdateMerchant.Request` with the same fields, `GetMerchants.Response.Merchant(id, name: String, notes, categoryId: Option[UUID], taxId, reviewed, createdAt)`, `GetRefunds.Response.Refund`) and `lib/common` (`MerchantName`) are read-only.
- Typed-form stack, from the external `net.wiringbits.webapp.utils.slinkyUtils.forms` / `webapp.common.validators`: `FormField[T](label, name, required, value: Option[ValidationResult[T]])` with `.updated(ValidationResult[T])`, `.valueOpt: Option[T]` (None when invalid or blank-required) and `.inputValue: String`. `FormData[R]` has `fields: List[FormField[?]]`, `isValid`, `submitRequest: Option[R]` and an overridable `formValidationErrors`. `ValidationResult.Valid(input, value)` / `Invalid(input, error)` provide `.toOption`, `.input`, `.hasError` and `.errorMessage`. `TextValidator[T]` is `String => ValidationResult[T]`.

KEY FILES
- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpNotes.scala`: the template for the new `ExpTaxId` (WrappedString clone; `validate` trims and bounds; `trusted`; `parse`; `given optionalValidator = OptionalValidator.optional(validate)`). The non-optional `TextValidator` comes from `WrappedString.Companion`, which is why `NotesInput extends ValidatedTextInput[ExpNotes]` compiles. `ExpNotes.MaxLength = 500`.
- `ui/forms/OptionalValidator.scala`: `optional[T](validate): TextValidator[Option[T]]`, where blank or whitespace gives `Valid(input, None)`.
- `ui/forms/ExpOptionalId.scala`: `validate(s): ValidationResult[Option[UUID]]` (blank → None, a UUID → Some, otherwise the error \"Select a valid entry\"), plus `given validator`. Because `UUID` has no Scala companion, pass `(using ExpOptionalId.validator)` explicitly when needed.
- `ui/forms/ExistingSelections.scala`: `defaultCategoryId(merchantId: Option[UUID], merchants: List[GetMerchants.Response.Merchant]): Option[UUID]`.
- `ui/components/inputs/expInputs.scala`: `OptionalNotesInput`, `NotesInput`, and `OptionalIdSelectInput extends ValidatedSelectInput[Option[UUID]](using ExpOptionalId.validator)`. Add the tax-id inputs here.
- `ui/components/core/widgets/ValidatedTextInput.scala`: `Props(field, disabled = false, onChange: ValidationResult[T] => Unit, margin, autoFocus)`. It is fullWidth, and its id/name are `ExperimentalTextInput-${field.name}`.
- `ui/components/core/widgets/ValidatedSelectInput.scala`: `Props(field, options: Seq[(String value, String label)], onChange, disabled = false)`. It adds its own \"(none)\" item keyed on `field.name`, is fullWidth, and takes its label from `field.label`. Wrap it in a sized `mui.Box`, as SubscriptionsPage's `fieldBox` does (around line 466).
- `ui/forms/SubmitHooks.scala`: the `useSubmit()` control provides `isSubmitting`, `buttonDisabled(canSubmit: Boolean)`, `begin()`, `succeed()`, `fail(msg)` and `reset()`.
- Reference FormData: `forms/BankRowRefundFormData.scala` (for-comprehension over every field's `valueOpt`; notes seeded via `ExpNotes.optionalValidator(raw)`) and `forms/ExpenseFormData.scala` (`merchantId: FormField[Option[UUID]]` seeded with `ExpOptionalId.validate(raw)`, prefixed field names `s\"$prefix-notes\"`).
- Targets: `forms/MerchantFormData.scala` (used only by `components/pages/merchants/MerchantsPage.scala`, object `MerchantList`) and `forms/RefundFormData.scala` (used only by `components/pages/expenses/RefundsPage.scala`, object `RefundList`). `RefundsPage` already gates buttons on `isValid`. `MerchantsPage` currently gates on `submitRequest.isDefined` and builds category MenuItems by hand, and its \"+ Cat\" flow writes `categoryId` directly from `resp.id`.
- Specs: `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/RefundFormDataSpec.scala` exists and must be rewritten for the new shape. `MerchantFormDataSpec` does not exist yet. `components/pages/merchants/MerchantListSpec.scala` only tests `isAtLimit`/`usageLabel`. Templates: `ui/forms/ExpNotesSpec.scala`, `ExpOptionalIdSpec.scala`, `forms/BankRowRefundFormDataSpec.scala`.

CONVENTIONS / REVIEWER GATES (`.orca/reviewers/frontend.md`, around lines 142–224)
- Every user input on a FormData is a `FormField` over a validated primitive and appears in `fields`. No raw String/UUID members.
- Optional fields use `Option[...]` with `required = false`. No hand-written required/validity checks in `formValidationErrors`.
- Seed from source data raw: no `.trim`, `.take` or `.trusted` on user or API values. Trimming at submit happens through the primitive (`.string` already holds the trimmed value).
- No hardcoded `.withKey(\"literal\")` inside reusable inputs; derive keys from `field.name`. JS interop stays inside components, and Props stay plain Scala.
- Every FormData change ships with a plain ScalaTest spec: `AnyWordSpec` + `org.scalatest.matchers.must.Matchers.*`, no jsdom, describe blocks named by method only (`\"submitRequest\" should {...}`).
- Scala 3 syntax (`given`, `*` imports, `FormField[?]`). Match the existing style and leave unrelated code alone. The public repo means no PII in test data.
- Both the create and edit forms render at once on MerchantsPage and RefundsPage, so give new field names a per-form prefix. Otherwise DOM ids collide.

BUILD / TEST
- Typecheck with `CI=true sbt Test/compile`. Run targeted tests with `sbt \"web/testOnly *XSpec\"`, adding `NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider` if needed. Do NOT run the full `sbt test`.
- Web tests need Node 24 on PATH (the default shell node is v16, and yarn install fails with it).
- Run `sbt scalafmtAll scalafmtSbt` before committing and re-stage the reformatted files. Make one commit per primitive/form.
- Server limit for reference: `CreateMerchantAction`/`UpdateMerchantAction` reject a tax id over 50 chars with \"Tax ID must be 50 characters or less\" and reject a blank one, which is why the client maps a blank tax id to None.

id.name: Task: Add ExpTaxId primitive, TaxIdInput/OptionalTaxIdInput, and ExpTaxIdSpec
